location: adapter for measurements-2026-10-24b (fig_status / samp lookup)
what_is_wrong: The result file's id is a row number in links.csv (links) or a registration (hours), not an edge_id or measurement_id. The adapter tests it against edges.csv / measurements.csv ids, so every link or hours finding with a problem gets 'changed or removed since', whether or not the row changed. entry_id and location are blank for all 36 rows.
evidence: BRIEF.md line 21: 'id (edge row number in links.csv counting from 1, or registration)'. Rows 12, 14 and 30 map to e-477f99f5ad, e-d41fd6ae4f and e-e00b6a34f6, which are still in data/chain/edges.csv with the same basis, yet their status is 'changed or removed since'. All six hours rows (m-dcf2551c2e, m-a213eec912, m-4fad81bf66, m-9794c457b0, m-1b982ea2f9, m-8bc639f36b) are still in measurements.csv with the same values (21527 still 'at least 4.9 hours', 74155 still 0.5 h, both flagged by the reader). Five of them say 'changed or removed since'. So 8 of 36 statuses are wrong, and the check's line on the page ('26 changed or removed since, 10 confirmed') overstates what was acted on.
suggested_fix: Map the id through links.csv (row n to edge_id) and hours.csv (registration to measurement_id) before calling fig_status, and take entry_id and location from those files.
resolution: corrected: links matched by row and hours by registration; statuses recomputed

location: status category 'changed or removed since' (and 'confirmed')

'confirmed' is set without checking whether the row still exists. Unlike the text categories, the docstring gives no caveat for this.

suggested_fix: Add a sentence to the docstring and page: 'changed' means any of these fields changed, not that the finding was answered. Or diff the old and new rows and name the field that changed.
resolution: corrected: statuses renamed (no longer in the table in the form checked; confirmed at the check) and the method says an unrelated edit can change a row
